name: @epoch/action-policy
description: Epoch Action Policy kernel (W022) — the typed policy EVALUATION layer over @epoch/action-protocol proposals and @epoch/policy-contracts policy sets: deterministic allow / deny / requires-approval decisions with FULL W004 provenance (matched policies, applied precedence, evaluated scope — reused, never re-implemented), sealed as content-addressed, per-proposal hash-chained append-only records (a decision is never mutated; a changed situation is a NEW decision with previousDecisionDigest); human approval as a first-class typed surface (approval directives with W009-shaped approver scope, quorum, deadline, delegation depth; approval and rejection as sealed records referencing the ORIGINAL decision digest — approval NEVER re-evaluates policy, drift is proposal-drift-rejected); replay/idempotency keyed on (proposal digest, policy-set digest); tenant-scoped decisions with cross-tenant proposal references typed tenant-isolation-rejected.
